text: honestly the secret to good carbonara is patience and NO cream. cream is a crime. fight me.
took the old Bronco up to Ridge Trail again before sunrise. nobody up there but me and the deer. that's the good stuff right there.
coffee first. opinions later. always in that order lol
my daughter Mia just beat me at chess for the first time. proud and furious simultaneously. she's 9. we're cooked.
PSA: measure twice, cut once. i have ruined more oak than i care to admit learning this.
rain on a tin roof + a good book. i don't need much honestly.
built Mia a little bookshelf this weekend. crooked as heck but she loves it. that's woodworking baby.
unpopular opinion: the original Blade Runner is better than 2049 and it's not close. the ambiguity IS the point.
5am. gym. no excuses. discipline is just love for your future self.
grief is weird. dad's been gone two years and i still reach for the phone to tell him the dumbest things.
if your chili has beans that's fine, i don't care what texas says. beans are good. this is my hill.
sunset over the ridge. no filter needed when the sky does the work.
reminder to self and anyone reading: call your mom. seriously. do it now.
spent 3 hours debugging only to find a missing semicolon. i love this job. i hate this job. both true.
Mia asked me tonight why the stars 'turn off' during the day. spent an hour on it. best conversation i've had all week.
cast iron rule: you don't wash it with soap, you don't let anyone else touch it, and you'd take a bullet for it.
thankful for: strong coffee, a warm dog, a kid who still laughs at my terrible jokes. that's the whole list and it's enough.
she got the telescope. i have never seen a human being this happy. worth every penny and the assembly instructions from hell.
new years resolution is the same as last year: be the man my dog thinks i am. still working on it.
cold plunge this morning was a mistake and i'd do it again. wake up, you're alive, act like it.
hot take: the best tool is the one you actually have with you. stop buying gadgets and go make something.
Mia's science fair project won. she built a working volcano AND explained the chemistry. i just held the poster board. proud dad reporting for duty.
restored grandpa's old hand plane today. 60 years old and it still sings through pine. they don't make em like this anymore.
you don't find time for the things that matter. you make it. period.
somebody asked what i'd tell my younger self. easy: slow down, hug people longer, and for the love of god stop pretending you're not scared. everyone is.
Hey kiddo — remember: measure twice, cut once, and always leave a place better than you found it. Love, Dad
The carbonara recipe, for real this time: guanciale, eggs, pecorino, black pepper, pasta water. NO cream. Ever. — Dad
